question: What is the base engine warranty duration?
reference_answer: 2 years or 2000 hours, whichever occurs first.

question: When does the warranty start for a stationary fire pump drive engine?
reference_answer: On the date of initial start-up, demonstration or eighteen months after the factory ship date, whichever is sooner.

The engine will not stop after the fire pump controller is switched off. What do I check, in order?
reference_answer: First stop the engine. The chart shows this order if it will not stop: turn the fire pump controller OFF, press STOP/RESET on the panel, press and hold the side Engine STOP button, then cut off the fuel supply if it still will not stop. Only after the engine has stopped, troubleshoot in this order: (1) Confirm the controller is OFF. (2) Check for B+ at TB-1 from the controller. If present, contact the controller manufacturer or installing contractor. (3) If no B+, check whether the panel is in MANUAL. If so, select AUTO and restart. (4) Otherwise open the panel and check whether the Manual Keyswitch Override toggle is to the RIGHT. If so, move it LEFT and restart. (5) If not, note AUTO WAKE (LED 7) and KEY FB (LED 49) and call Cummins.

question: The panel shows low battery voltage. At what reading do I need to replace the battery?
reference_answer: Below 10 volts on the panel. Make this check with the engine stopped, the fire pump controller OFF and the controller battery chargers disconnected, as the chart specifies.
